subject: FluxForge integration: commercial terms & lead registration proposal
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan@fluxforge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FluxForge integration: commercial terms & lead registration proposal

Hi Ethan —

Really enjoyed the integration demo yesterday. The engineering teams are confident we can ship a first connector in Q4 that will support streaming inference and the shared telemetry hooks you requested. Per our conversation, attaching an initial revenue-share term sheet for your review (FluxForge_RvShare_Draft_v3.docx).

Key ask from our side: a simplified lead-registration window and a clear commission waterfall for referrals that convert to paid contracts. Our proposed structure in the draft (high level):
- 10% revenue share on first 12 months of net ARR for direct referrals that originate from FluxForge leads and convert to Redwood-paid accounts.
- 5% referral credit for qualified demo-only leads that convert after a co-sell effort.
- 12 month registration window with a 90-day MQL→SQL qualification clause.
- 12 month clawback if the customer cancels during the first 90 days.

Can you review and flag anything that would be a dealbreaker for you from a marketplace/ISV perspective? Also curious if you need an exclusivity carveout for any existing reseller relationships.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call this week.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0197
From: Ethan Cole <ethan@fluxforge.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: partnerships@fluxforge.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Jul 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FluxForge integration: commercial terms & lead registration proposal

Kim —

Thanks for the draft and for the call. Overall this looks promising and the teams are excited. A few initial items from our side:

1) Registration window: +/- 12 months feels long for enterprise deals where procurement cycles stretch. Can we consider 9 months for standard registrations but allow 12 months for named accounts we jointly approve?

2) Tiered shares: can we add a performance kicker — e.g., 15% for first year if ARR > $250k within first 6 months?

3) Trial credits and co-marketing: we want a $25k trial credit budget that is split 50/50 for joint pilots. How does Redwood track and reconcile pilot credits?

4) Marketplace listing: we need a clear SLA on listing cadence and who owns the listing content/updates.

I attached a lightly redlined copy with some suggested language (we'll send formally after legal review).

Ethan
VP Partnerships, FluxForge
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: FluxForge integration: commercial terms & lead registration proposal

Marissa / Ben —

Looping you in on FluxForge's reply. Key asks: shorten registration window to 9 months (with exceptions), add a performance kicker (15% >$250k), and a $25k pilot credit pool (50/50). Also want clarity around marketplace listing ownership.

My take:
- We can accept a 9-month default registration window if we add an "approved named account" exception to 12 months and keep the 90-day clawback.
- Performance kicker is fine but let's gate it to net-new customers and revenue recognized within first 180 days. Need finance to confirm payout cadence.
- Pilot credits: we should accept but add a clear reconciliation cadence and require FluxForge to submit a POC acceptance form.

Can you draft replies for legal/finance-friendly language? Also want a short commercial one-pager for their execs and a consolidated SOW template. Attaching Redwood_SOW_template_v2.pdf for reference.

-Kim

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 10:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FluxForge integration: commercial terms & lead registration proposal

Kim / Marissa —

I reviewed FluxForge's asks with finance. Short answers / suggested language:

- Registration window: we can set default at 9 months, with a process to escalate named-account exceptions to 12 months — require written approval from Partnerships director (Kim) plus Revenue ops sign-off.

- Performance kicker: fine, but pay the kicker only on collected revenue (not billed ARR) within the first year. Suggest: 15% of collected revenue beyond $250k threshold, paid after month 12 reconciliation. This protects against early churn.

- Trial credits: Redwood can commit to $12.5k matching credits; require FluxForge to submit an intake form and have a single pooled trial budget per joint pilot. We will reconcile credit usage monthly — any unused credit reverts at 90 days.

- Marketplace listing: Redwood will own the listing content, FluxForge will provide assets and approve quarterly updates. We can add a 30-day SLA for critical updates.

I'll draft a short legal-friendly clause set and send today.

-ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FluxForge integration: commercial terms & lead registration proposal

Team —

Thanks Ben — those tradeoffs make sense. A few operational details to capture in the one-pager / term sheet:
- Lead registration workflow: FluxForge submits deal registration via our portal (HubSpot integration). Registrations need a primary contact, estimated ACV, and product scope.
- Qualification window: MQL→SQL within 90 days; if not qualified FluxForge can re-submit after 120 days with updated evidence.
- Attribution: if FluxForge introduced the account but Redwood closed the deal via outbound, credit flows 50/50 unless FluxForge provided >50% of the technical validation work (to be documented).
- Clawback: pro rata over 90 days; customer cancellations within first 90 days will trigger a clawback on payouts.

I'll assemble a one-page commercial summary and attach the term language for legal. Target to send to FluxForge EOD Friday.

-Marissa

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan@fluxforge.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FluxForge integration: commercial terms & lead registration proposal

Ethan —

Thanks for the thoughtful feedback. We've reviewed internally and are happy to move forward on the following consolidated points (attached: updated term sheet):

- Registration window: 9 months default; named-account exception to 12 months with written approval.
- Revenue share: 10% standard; 15% kicker applies after $250k collected revenue within first 180 days, paid after 12mo reconciliation.
- Trial credits: Redwood to match $12.5k (50/50 split of your asked $25k). Credits reconciled monthly; unused credits expire after 90 days.
- Marketplace: Redwood owns listing, FluxForge to provide assets and approve quarterly updates; 30-day SLA for critical updates.
- Attribution & clawback: 90-day pro rata clawback on cancellations; 50/50 default attribution unless FluxForge provides >50% technical validation.

Next steps: please confirm acceptance of the above terms and sign the attached term sheet via DocuSign (link included). We propose a follow-up pilot SOW for a two-week proof-of-concept once signatures are complete.

If you prefer, I can set a 30-minute call next week to walk the commercial one-pager.

Best,
Kimberly
Head of Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
